note:
Trial 23 ended by timeout. The screen shows "TRIAL END: TIMEOUT" with the spider still alive on the hill ahead.

What happened, from the screenshots:
- The only mob I saw was a single spider. It was visible at the start at center screen, then moved out of view while I advanced.
- In daylight the spider was passive and kept wandering, so I spent most of the trial scanning in a full rotation to relocate it. I found it twice, each time at range, and it moved off again before I could close.
- The last screenshot shows the spider still far away on the hill when the limit expired. My health bar stayed full the whole time, and I never landed or attempted an attack.

No input problems were observed. Camera turns and movement responded as expected. The main failure was navigation: each act call covered only a short distance, and the wandering spider outpaced my approach within the 90-second limit.
